The '''Kessel sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]].<ref name="THG" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kessel_sector.jpg|thumb|left|210px|The Kessel sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Kessel system was first mentioned in ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'', written by [[A. C. Crispin]] ([[1997]]). Shortly after this publication, the computer game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] ([[1998]]) placed Kessel in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]. ''Rebellion'' made a number of arbitrary placements of planets for game-play purposes; consequently, [[Leland Chee]], [[Holocron continuity database|Keeper of the Holocron]], has stated that when its placements conflict with existing [[canon]] placements, they are overridden.<ref name="Tasty">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=15#3897382|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-05-01|time=1:40 PM}}</ref> Its placement of Kessel is one such example to which this ruling applies.
